title: AFCON knockout race intensifies as groups C and D to wrap up
summary: The Africa's Football Cup of Nations will see two group wrap up as Groups C and D teams play their last games in Morocco on December 30. Teams will be looking to qualify for the competition's round of 16, with Senegal being the big favourites alongside host nation Morocco. FRANCE 24's Selina Sykes reports directly from Rabat and tells us what to know ahead…
